subject: Service adjustment & goodwill credit schedule — Helix Labs
messages:
From: James Park <james.park@helixlabs.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: ops@helixlabs.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike + short outage on May 1 — request for remediation and credit

Vanessa,

We saw a persistent latency spike across our production inference routes beginning ~08:40 PDT on May 1 and a brief routing flap that caused ~18 minutes of increased error rates. This impacted two customer-facing features and triggered our on-call runbooks. We already sent logs to your support queue (ticket RW-5892) but need to discuss commercial remediation and assurance this won't recur.

Can you confirm what happened, and whether Redwood can provide a goodwill credit or invoice offset for the impacted window? Our renewal is coming up in June and the team needs clarity on operational reliability and how you plan to prevent similar events.

Thanks,
James Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Helix Labs

Attachment: helix_latency_dive_May01-02.pdf (latency timeline + sample traces)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: James Park <james.park@helixlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike + short outage on May 1 — request for remediation and credit

James — thanks for the note and for the trace bundle. I’m really sorry about the disruption; I understand how visible those incidents are for you.

Quick summary: support has ingested the traces and our SREs are running a post-mortem. Initial signal points at an autoscaling mis-routing during a zone maintenance window; there was a KV-cache refill storm that amplified tail latency for ~18 minutes. I do not want to give placeholders while the SREs confirm the full root cause, but I want to propose a tangible remediation offer now so you can plan ahead of renewal discussions.

Proposal (initial, pending formal approval):
- Immediate: 30% one-time credit on the May invoice for the impacted service routes (applied as an invoice adjustment).
- Voucher: One service-credit month (equivalent to a single full-month invoice applied as a voucher you can redeem within 6 months).
- Ops: joint runbook session + 2 follow-up health check calls over next 60 days.

I’ve attached a short worksheet with the proposed schedule. I'll need internal sign-off for the 30% invoice credit + voucher; copying Marissa and Jonas to route for approvals and to confirm the financial and CS commitments. Would you be comfortable with that structure while we complete the RCA?

—Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Helix Labs remediation proposal — approval request (financials attached)

Karthik / Jonas — forwarding Vanessa's thread with Helix. Context: Helix is a mid-enterprise renewal in June for ~$225k ARR. The outage window and tail-latency impact are limited but customer-visible; risk of a procurement-level churn conversation is material.

Recommended concession package for exec approval (structured to balance goodwill and precedent):
1) 30% one-time invoice credit on the May billing for the impacted routes (estimated credit ~$18,750).
2) One service-credit month (voucher) redeemable within 6 months; voucher reduces cash churn risk and gives Helix runway.
3) No change to contracted SLOs; instead, add a 6-month remediation appendix that commits to runbook updates, a dedicated SRE point-of-contact for 30 days, and two joint health checks.

Attachments: proposed_credit_schedule_Helix.xlsx — includes line-item math and accounting impact.

Asking for authorization to apply the invoice credit and issue the voucher. If approved, we will update the billing record (Ops/Ticket RW-5892), send a formal SLA letter, and schedule the first runbook session.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Helix Labs remediation proposal — ops commitments

+1 to Marissa's recommendation. From CS perspective we should require two deliverables in the remediation appendix:
- A documented change to autoscaling config and a new guardrail for KV-cache refill thresholds (we will engage SRE to author).
- A rollback/fallback policy for routing that we can test in a tabletop exercise with Helix during the first week after the credits are applied.

On the commercial side, the 30% credit + voucher is reasonable and aligns with precedent for a single short incident. Recommend we include a clause that the voucher is void if duplication of a similar severity incident occurs within 90 days — to discourage gaming the remedial credit.

Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Success
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix Labs remediation proposal — approval

Approved as proposed.

Authorize: 30% one-time invoice credit (apply to May invoice, billing adjustment RW-5892) and issuance of one service-credit month voucher redeemable within 6 months. Conditions:
1) Sales Ops (Marissa) to record the credit in billing and HubSpot (link below) and tag the account for a 90-day elevated SRE monitoring window.
2) CS (Jonas) to schedule the joint runbook tabletop and confirm SRE action items.
3) Legal to sign a short remediation appendix (draft attached: sla-amendment-draft.docx) and we will get Helix's acceptance before voucher redemption.

Vanessa — please send James a confirmation email today and attach the amendment draft plus the billing worksheet. After Helix signs, Ops to apply the credit and create the voucher. Keep me posted on acceptance.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Revenue Operations
